description: Ranger 2 is Sonardyne's USBL acoustic positioning system, made up of software, a topside transceiver and in-water transponders. It can track targets such as ROVs, AUVs and towfish, act as a vessel DP position reference, and exchange data with seabed instruments. It is recommended for large vessels and USVs and also comes in smaller Mini-Ranger 2 and Micro-Ranger 2 versions.
features: Tracks up to 99 targets at once
Usable as a DP position reference; supports industry standard DP telegrams
Supports acoustically aided INS
Wideband 2 digital acoustics for shallow and deep water
Mini and Micro versions share the same platform

description: SPRINT-Nav DP is a DP position reference sensor for shallow water that combines inertial sensors, a DVL/ADCP and a pressure sensor in one titanium housing. It initialises from GNSS and can then run independently of GNSS, giving an independent reference for DP2 and DP3 operations. It connects to the DP desk using standard GNSS telegrams.
features: Position reference independent of GNSS in shallow water
Dual function DVL/ADCP with water current profiling
Internal battery rides through power dropouts
Onboard data logging and remote diagnostics
Not ITAR controlled

brand_note: Navigation Sensor Hub (NSH), Type 8098, confirmed. Hint items (dual Ethernet, trigger/responder modules) are interface cards; the page only says a range of plug-in cards exists, so specific card names are UNVERIFIED.
description: The NSH is a 2U rack-mounted unit that links the in-water transponders, the vessel transceiver and the Marine Computer running Ranger 2 USBL or Marksman LUSBL software. It time-stamps incoming gyro, VRU and GNSS data and powers and communicates with transceivers such as the HPT 5000 or HPT 7000. Plug-in interface cards at the rear let it grow from simple to complex acoustic operations.
features: 2U rack unit for Ranger 2 and Marksman LUSBL systems
Sub-microsecond time stamping with IEEE-1588/PTP source linked to GPS PPS
Up to 16 serial ports (RS232/485)
Stand-alone, dual-independent or dual-redundant modes
12 interface card connectors

description: The Bandak lightweight Taut Wire is a position reference system for deck-mounted port or starboard positions on surface vessels. A wire held at constant tension by a depressor weight on the seabed and a pneumatic and electric servo-assisted mooring system moves the gimbal head when the vessel moves, and potentiometers turn that into analogue signals. It has a stable A-frame construction and separate control electronics for all-weather operation.
features: Main or supplementary DP position reference
Operational water depth up to 500 m
Highly stable A-frame construction
Tension monitoring
Options: remote control panel, cold environment version to -30 C (no icing)
